message.content:
Three small portal-polish items from the Nxeon board Ideas column. Work ONLY in `/opt/nxeon-wt-polish` (branch feature/idea-polish). Commit + push. Do NOT run npm build/prisma — write code + `npx tsc --noEmit`. Theme = navy/violet/cyan glass, Geist. Reference images are provided — LOOK at them with Read before building.

## 1. Nxeon DB Studio logo (board card "nxeon db studio logo")
The DB Studio panel header currently shows a plain "N" chip + text "Nxeon DB Studio". The owner provided a logo to use instead. Read `/tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/ideas-refs/dbstudio.png` and `.../dbstudio_1.png` (one is the logo, the other may show where it goes — use the one that IS the logo). Copy the logo into `public/logos/nxeon-db-studio.png` (in the worktree) and render it in the DB Studio header (`components/customer/hosting/DbManager.tsx`, where "Nxeon DB Studio BETA" is shown) via next/image, replacing the plain "N" tile. Keep the "BETA" badge + title text next to it (or as the logo dictates). Size it tastefully.

## 2. Claude logo consistency (board card "Claude logo")
Read `.../ideas-refs/claude.png` — the owner's correct Claude logo. Find everywhere a Claude/Anthropic logo or a placeholder "fake" Claude mark is rendered in the system — marketing side (e.g. components/marketing/showcase/ClaudeChat, ClaudeBuilder, any "Build with AI" branding) AND customer portal (the Build-with-AI / claude-code area). Grep for existing claude logo usage (`grep -rn "claude" components/ public/ | grep -iE "logo|svg|png|Claude"`). Place the provided logo at `public/logos/claude.png` and swap all inconsistent/placeholder Claude marks to use it, so it's consistent everywhere. Don't touch functional code — just the logo asset references.

## 3. Wallet balance sidebar CSS (board card "wallet balance in sidebar css improvement")
The sidebar's "Account Balance $X" block looks stale/all-gray. Read `.../ideas-refs/wallet.png` and `.../ideas-refs/wallet_1.png` (the owner's desired look). Find the sidebar wallet-balance component (likely in `components/portal/` or the dashboard sidebar/Shell — grep "Account Balance" / "balanceCents" in the sidebar). Restyle it to match the reference: more premium (accent color for the amount, a subtle card/glow, maybe a small wallet icon), in our theme (violet/cyan). Keep it DB-fed (real balance), just improve the visual.

## Rules
No money/charge logic. Prices/balances stay DB-fed. tsc clean. Commit + push origin/feature/idea-polish. Report each of the 3 with what you changed + which reference you matched. Previews on staging.

content.text:
All three items are done, typecheck is clean, and the branch `feature/idea-polish` is committed and pushed to origin. Work was done entirely in `/opt/nxeon-wt-polish`; no build/prisma run.

## 1. Nxeon DB Studio logo
Matched reference `dbstudio.png` (the horizontal "NX XEON DB STUDIO" wordmark with the hexagon/database icon — that's the actual logo; `dbstudio_1.png` was the placement context showing the header). Trimmed its whitespace with sharp (1680x936 → 1334x384) and saved it to `/opt/nxeon-wt-polish/public/logos/nxeon-db-studio.png`.
- `components/customer/hosting/DbManager.tsx`: replaced the plain gradient "N" tile + "Nxeon DB Studio" h3 with the logo via `next/image` (h-8, auto width, subtle violet drop-shadow), keeping the "Browse, query & edit your databases" subtitle beneath it. The wordmark now lives in the image so the redundant text title was dropped. The status badge (connected/preparing/unavailable) is untouched — note there was no literal "BETA" badge in the code, just that status pill.

## 2. Claude logo consistency
Matched reference `claude.png` (the coral/clay Anthropic sunburst). Saved as transparent RGBA to `/opt/nxeon-wt-polish/public/logos/claude.png` (confirmed corner alpha=0). Made `components/marketing/ClaudeMark.tsx` the single source of truth — it now renders the asset via `next/image` while keeping its `{size, className}` API, so every existing consumer (LogoMarquee, ProductShowcase, MarketingHeader menu) uses the real logo automatically. Then swapped every inconsistent placeholder "spark" mark to the same asset:
- `components/marketing/ClaudeBuilder.tsx` — removed local 4-point `Spark`, now uses `ClaudeMark` (2 spots)
- `components/marketing/showcase/ClaudeChat.tsx` — removed local `Spark`, uses `ClaudeMark` (ScreenFrame icon + input chip)
- `app/(marketing)/features/page.tsx` — removed local `SparkIcon`, flagship "Build with Claude AI" pill now uses `ClaudeMark`
- `components/customer/claude-code/ClaudeCodeHub.tsx` — `ClaudeGlyph` (hand-drawn sunburst SVG) now renders the asset

Left alone deliberately (functional/terminal, not logos): the `✳` clay-colored prefix glyphs in terminal chat logs (ClaudeCodeHub, vibe-coding page) that mimic the real claude CLI, the generic `IconSpark` feature-card icons, the `from-[#D97757]` gradient chip accent behind the Claude row in ProductShowcase, and `AppLogo`'s `claude: "✦"` fallback (grep confirms AppLogo is never invoked with the "claude" key).

## 3. Wallet balance sidebar
Matched reference `wallet_1.png` (labeled "Account Balance" card with a bright accent amount vs. the old flat gray "Balance: $X"). In `components/portal/Shell.tsx` replaced the plain text line with a premium glass card: violet→cyan gradient, soft border, glow shadow, a corner blur accent, an "Account Balance" uppercase label with a small wallet icon, and the amount in glowing cyan (on-theme substitute for the reference's green, per the violet/cyan brief). Still DB-fed from `user.balanceCents` — no money/charge logic changed. The email moved just below the card, and the card correctly hides when the sidebar is collapsed.

Typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. Previews will be on staging.
